title: structured-output: constrained-decoding backends - tokenizer unicode/regression fallbacks and streaming stability fixes
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: Constrained decoding (CFG/regex backends) has regressed on certain multilingual inputs and grapheme clusters (ZWJ sequences, combining marks, and emoji sequences). In streaming paths we also saw intermittent tokenization boundary issues that caused partial token emission for constrained requests. This PR fixes tokenizer edge-cases, improves regex backend Unicode support, and adds a robust fallback path to byte/byte-pair token matching for sequences that cannot be mapped cleanly to token boundaries. It also includes a streaming stability mitigation for constrained decoding where we buffer until constraint checkpoints are reached. Changes: 1) Tokenizer: handle Unicode grapheme clusters and zero-width joiners explicitly when constructing prefix invariants for constrained decoders; add fallback to byte-level token scanning for non-normalizable spans. 2) Regex backend: switch to ICU/Unicode property classes for character classes used in constraint compilation, and add normalizing preprocessor step for NFKC when user-provided regexes request Unicode-aware matching. 3) CFG backend: ensure node-to-token alignment accounts for multi-token graphemes and update the acceptance check to use token-segment boundaries rather than codepoint indices. 4) Streaming: defer emission of partial tokens for constrained requests until constraint-safe checkpoints, reducing observed partial-output failures in streaming clients. 5) OpenAI compatibility layer: expose structured_constraints param in the compat layer so external users can pass legacy regex/grammar constraints via the OpenAI-like API. 6) Tests: add intensive fuzz tests for Unicode edgecases, unit tests for regex/CFG backends, and an end-to-end streaming integration test. Compatibility & rollout: backward-compatible for unconstrained requests. Constrained decoding behavior is preserved except for previously-broken Unicode sequences which now match expected outputs. Rollout will be staged behind a feature flag (constrained_unicode_fallback) and toggled for Canary then all regions. Testing: CI added heavy fuzz stage; ran internal canary on dedicated infra with a curated corpus of emoji + CJK + combining diacritics. See linked Linear tasks for evaluation failing items.
commits: feat(tokenizer): handle grapheme clusters and ZWJ sequences in prefix invariants
fix(regex): use ICU property classes and add NFKC preprocessor for unicode-aware regexes
fix(cfg): align CFG nodes to token-segment boundaries
feat(streaming): buffer until constraint checkpoints for constrained decoding
compat(openai): expose structured_constraints param in compat layer
test: add unicode fuzz suite and streaming integration test

release_notes: Fix: constrained decoding Unicode/tokenizer edge-cases and streaming stability improvements. Expose structured_constraints in OpenAI compat layer. Rollout behind constrained_unicode_fallback feature flag.
